summary: Phase-1 UX Audit (read-only). Walked every route in App.js (52 routes) as 3 personas (president, division-secretary, secretary). Deep-dived focus pages (Tournaments, Players, Grant Claims, Members/Org, Discussions). Produced the UX Debt Register at /app/test_reports/iteration_ux_audit.json. NO CODE CHANGES.

issues: 329 buttons, 11 filter chips, competing CTAs — cognitive overload for 45+ admin
129 inputs on a single scroll — inline-edit hell
124 buttons, TEST_ campaigns in prod, 7 actions per row
10-stage progression rendered as passive stepper — not clickable navigation
201 rows loaded, 41k chars, no visible pagination
Public routes leak unshipped design scratchpad

action_items: Follow the Phase-2 Cleave plan in /app/test_reports/iteration_ux_audit.json > recommendations_for_main_agent
Confirm claim-surface consolidation with user (destructive merge)
Purge TEST_ campaigns from /player-registrations before deploy
Investigate division-secretary Indore Pre-Camp visibility (child of Parmanand? or filter bug?)
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has 52 <Route> entries — heavy route surface for a domain that has ~10 concepts.
GrantClaims.jsx at 876 lines is the heaviest page but is well-architected (two-pane, testids everywhere).
Multiple pages have >100 buttons (Players 329, Player Registrations 124) suggesting per-row action explosion; refactor to kebab overflow menus.
Rate-cards page renders 129 form inputs simultaneously — should be drawer/wizard pattern.
/design-lab and /design-preview are public routes — should be auth-gated or removed.
test_credentials: Persona chips on /login (data-testid=persona-chip-<id>), submit via data-testid=login-submit-btn. IDs: president, secretary, treasurer, division-secretary, division-secretary-gwl, district-secretary, match-official, public.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is the Phase-1 output. After main agent executes any subset of the Phase-2 Cleave plan, re-run broad_sweep script (in ux_audit iteration file) as each persona and diff route count / body-length / button-count against this baseline.
